name: Alistigo Artifact Concept — AI Environment, iframe Sandbox, Artifact Runtime
description: The conceptual runtime an Alistigo artifact executes inside. A human 'ai-user' drives an AI agent through a chat interface. That chat interface embeds a network-isolated iframe whose only boundary in or out is a postMessage 'message-bus'. An Alistigo artifact is a web-app loaded from a CDN (jsDelivr) that runs inside that iframe, renders the UI the user interacts with, and reaches the AI API and a key-storage store only by sending messages across the bus. Conceptual model — not a package/deployment view. See ADR 0027 (CALM) and docs/research/claude-artifacts-capabilities.md.

metadata.note: Contract details on the message-bus node are Claude/Anthropic-specific; other AI environments would expose a different contract.

nodes.name: AI user
nodes.description: A human user working through an AI agent. Only ever interacts with the chat interface and with the UI the artifact renders inside the iframe — never with the AI API, key-storage, or message-bus directly.

nodes.name: AI environment
nodes.description: The AI product the user talks to (e.g. Claude). Hosts the chat interface, the AI API, and a persistent key-storage store. Owns and mediates every capability the sandboxed artifact is granted.

interfaces.description: Everything the artifact can reach is brokered by this environment; the artifact has no ambient authority of its own.

nodes.name: AI chat interface
nodes.description: The web or desktop application the user chats in, built on web standards (HTML/CSS/JavaScript). Renders the conversation, calls the AI API, and embeds the artifact iframe. It is the host side of the message-bus.

interfaces.description: Conversation UI rendered with HTML/CSS/JS; where the user reads and writes messages.
The <iframe sandbox='allow-scripts allow-same-origin'> element the artifact is mounted into.

nodes.name: AI API
nodes.description: The AI provider's API (for Claude, api.anthropic.com). Serves chat completions and tool calls. Reachable directly by the chat interface; reachable by the artifact only as a proxied request forwarded across the message-bus, with credentials injected host-side.

nodes.name: Key storage
nodes.description: Persistent key-value store inside the AI environment (for Claude, the window.storage API). The artifact loads and saves its keys/values here by asking the message-bus to do it — the artifact never holds a storage handle itself.

metadata.semantics: last-write-wins; missing key throws — always try/catch

nodes.name: Artifact iframe (sandbox)
nodes.description: A sandboxed iframe running inside the chat interface. Network-isolated: no inbound or outbound network calls of its own. Its ONLY channel to anything outside is the postMessage message-bus. Script loading is further restricted by CSP to the CDN source allowlist. Encapsulates the Alistigo environment.

interfaces.note: no allow-forms, no allow-popups, no allow-top-navigation

metadata.network-isolation: no outgoing or incoming network; native fetch/XHR/WebSocket to arbitrary origins is blocked
metadata.csp-script-src: loads code only from origins in the cdn-source-allowlist
metadata.storage: localStorage / sessionStorage unavailable; persistence is via key-storage over the bus

nodes.name: Message bus (postMessage)
nodes.description: The single, two-way boundary between the iframe and the rest of the AI environment. Implemented with window.postMessage. Every capability the artifact uses — receiving its config, calling the AI API, reading and writing key-storage — is a message across this bus. The message contract depends on the AI environment; the contract below is the Claude/Anthropic one.

host-to-iframe: responses to artifact-initiated AI API calls (proxied)
iframe-to-host: AI API request to proxy (forwarded to api.anthropic.com only; no API key — auth injected host-side)
key-storage operation: get / set / delete / list (private or shared)
explicitly-not-available: arbitrary fetch to non-Anthropic origins (blocked even if CSP-listed)

nodes.name: CDN source allowlist
nodes.description: The enumerated set of external origins the iframe's CSP permits code to be loaded from. An Alistigo artifact bundle is loaded from one of these (jsDelivr). This is a load-time allowlist only — it does NOT grant the artifact fetch/XHR access to those origins at runtime.

metadata.scope: script-src at load time only; not a connect-src / runtime fetch grant

nodes.name: Alistigo environment
nodes.description: The Alistigo runtime, encapsulated inside the artifact iframe. Everything Alistigo does happens within the sandbox and speaks to the outside world exclusively through the message-bus.

interfaces.description: Bounded by the iframe; no capability beyond what the message-bus brokers.

nodes.name: Alistigo artifact
nodes.description: A concrete Alistigo artifact: a web-app (UMD bundle) loaded from jsDelivr that runs inside the iframe. It renders the UI the user sees and interacts with, and uses the message-bus to reach the AI API and to load/save keys from key-storage.

interfaces.description: The visible UI surface inside the iframe — the place the user interacts with the artifact.

metadata.delivery: npm package published, served as a versioned UMD bundle via jsDelivr (ADR 0011)
metadata.outbound-capabilities: AI API calls and key-storage reads/writes, both only via the message-bus

relationships.description: Is composed of the chat interface, the AI API, and the key-storage store
Embeds and hosts the sandboxed artifact iframe
Encapsulates the Alistigo environment; the iframe is the security and network boundary around it
Sends prompts, conversation state and tool calls to, and streams completions back from
Two-way postMessage channel; the host side of the iframe's only boundary. Sends config and brokered responses in, receives proxied AI API calls and key-storage ops out
Two-way postMessage channel; the artifact side of the iframe's only boundary. The artifact has no other way to reach anything outside the sandbox
Forwards the artifact's proxied AI API requests to (api.anthropic.com only; credentials injected host-side, no key in the iframe)
Loads and saves the artifact's keys in, on behalf of the sandboxed artifact (window.storage bridge)
Loaded at runtime as a versioned web-app bundle from a jsDelivr URL — an origin in
CSP script-src permits code to be loaded only from the origins enumerated in; grants no runtime fetch access to them
Chats with the AI through the web/desktop chat UI, and directly interacts with the artifact's rendered UI inside the iframe
